dailyTopNewsBrief.headline: Texans (4-6) Week 12 Briefing: Injury Updates Ahead of Ravens
bullets: Roster & Front Office: Houston signed DT Junior Tafuna and WR Daniel Sobkowicz to the practice squad and released RB Dare Ogunbowale on Wednesday. We have signed Junior Tafuna and Daniel Sobkowicz to the practice squad [NFL Trade Rumors](https://nfltraderumors.co/texans-announce-three-roster-moves/).

Injury & Practice Status: Entering Week 12 preparation, head coach DeMeco Ryans and the medical staff evaluate RB Woody Marks (concussion), WR Marvin Harrison Jr. (hamstring), DE Danielle Hunter (hamstring), and TE Brevin Jordan (foot) ahead of Wednesday's initial participation report [Jonathan M. Alexander](https://www.espn.com/nfl/player/_/id/4429059/woody-marks#:~:text=Marks%20%28concussion%29%20was%20on%20the%20practice%20field).

Week 12 Ravens Outlook: DeMeco Ryans and DC Matt Burke open installation for the Baltimore Ravens (4-7, HOU -7, HC Jesse Minter, OC Declan Doyle & DC Anthony Weaver (NRG Stadium)) as Houston prepares for a pivotal AFC matchup [houstontexans.com Official](https://www.houstontexans.com/news/texans-participate-in-nfl-s-2026-my-cause-my-cleats-initiative) [fizzyjoe](https://www.battleredblog.com/houston-texans-power-rankings/79275/houston-texans-nfl-power-rankings-week-12).

AFC Playoff Trajectory: Entering Week 12 at 4-6 (2nd in AFC South • #9 Seed in AFC), Houston carries a 22.7% postseason projection, 5.4% AFC South division title mark, and 0% #1 Seed Bye equity into the conference stretch [houstontexans.com Official](https://www.houstontexans.com/news/houston-texans-de-will-anderson-jr-named-afc-defensive-player-of-the-week).

Statistical Profile & Matchup Edge: Through Week 11, Houston ranks #9 in Points / Game (25.9), #17 in Points Allowed / Game (22.2), #10 in Turnover Differential (+4), giving DeMeco Ryans and Matt Burke a clear benchmark ahead of Sun, Nov 29, 12:00 PM CST • NFL TV at [object Object] against the Baltimore Ravens [Scott Barzilla](https://www.battleredblog.com/houston-texans-analysis/79219/value-of-things-by-the-numbers).
